description:
Update a signer's information. Only supplied fields change; send `null` or an empty string to clear `email`, `whatsapp_phone_number`, or `government_id`.

**Verification integrity:** `email` / `whatsapp_phone_number` cannot be changed while the signer has verified that channel on an in-flight (not yet certificated) document — the response is `400` naming the offending document(s). Already-certificated documents do not block updates. Changing a channel that has *unverified* in-flight requests rotates their access/verification codes (invalidating previously sent links/OTPs); use the resend endpoint to redeliver. `full_name` can always be updated.

account_id.description: Authorized workspace; discovered from OAuth when omitted.

email.description: A valid email address, or null/empty to clear it.

government_id.description: Signer's CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 characters; may be alphanumeric). Formatting is accepted and the value is normalized on save. Required before the signer can use a verification method that identifies them by CPF. Null/empty clears it.

whatsapp_phone_number.description: E.164 and normalized on save; null/empty clears it.

name: assinafy_update_signer
title: Update signer
